mechanism: Ginkgo biloba inhibits platelet-activating factor and has antiplatelet effects, which may potentiate the bleeding risk; additionally, ginkgo may inhibit CYP2D6 metabolism of propranolol, potentially increasing propranolol levels.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding and reduced propranolol efficacy; consider using alternative herbal supplement or monitor heart rate and blood pressure more closely if combination is necessary.
